scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && BUILD_ID=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d.%H%MZ) && npx esbuild synth-main.js --bundle --conditions=source --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/synth.js && npx esbuild synth/worklet.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/worklet.js && sed "s/__BUILD_ID__/$BUILD_ID/g" index.html > dist/index.html && cp synth/vane-dsp.wasm dist/vane-dsp.wasm && echo "vane build $BUILD_ID"
